observations: One physical game case for FIFA 22.
Watermark 'CHIBROS MUSICALS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the image.

claims.evidence: FIFA 26 does not exist; the series ended with FIFA 23.
Requires a clear photo of the warranty seal on the rear of the console.
No receipt is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN)
risks.proof: Video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: Optical disc drive may be faulty
risks.proof: Video of the console loading and launching a physical disc.

risks.risk: Controllers may be third-party clones or have stick drift
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear labels and a video of a controller test.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen in settings.

proof_requests: Photo of the warranty seal on the back of the console.
Photo of the system information screen showing storage and software version.
Video of the console running a game and connecting to the internet.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
response.reason: The seller claims to include 'FIFA 26', a game that does not exist, and 'FIFA 24' while the photo shows 'FIFA 22'. These blatant factual errors, combined with a business watermark for a different trade, are strong indicators of a scam.
